meta.title: Wolfram Mathematica
meta.description: Connects the local Wolfram Mathematica kernel as an MCP tool server: the agent can evaluate Wolfram Language code, inspect symbol definitions, read and write notebooks, run code inspection, and run test reports. Ask for a Wolfram Language computation and it uses the mcp__wolfram__* tools. Requires Mathematica 14.3+ with the Wolfram/AgentTools paclet and an active license (verified with 15.0.1); the default kernel is D:\Applications\Mathematica15.0\wolfram.exe. Each DSH launch starts two kernel processes, so tools appear some seconds in; when the kernel or license fails to start, they stay absent. One evaluation is capped at 5 minutes. Change command in Settings > Plugins, or turn the plugin off there to stop kernels.
